14. Charlie kisses Nick — an act of courage — and is immediately left alone in silence. He doesn't know if Nick is angry, scared, confused, or if their friendship is over. What does this moment reveal about the risk of being honest about your feelings? Why is it important for young readers to see characters facing this kind of uncertainty in stories?

🗣 Final discussion

Reflect on: "Charlie said sorry for something he didn't do wrong. Why do we sometimes feel like we have to apologise for who we are or what we feel? What would it take for Charlie — or anyone — to stop doing that?"
